# `gate_create`

**Open a gate.** Open a gate, and block the tasks waiting on it until it resolves.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Capability | `gate_create` |
| Side effect | `create` |
| Idempotency | keyed on `await_id` |
| Retry safe | no |
| Timeout | none |
| Preview | not supported |
